tips.text: Always use environment variables for API keys to keep them secure!
Comment your code as if the next person is a violent psychopath who knows where you live.
Use type hints in Python for better code readability.
Refactor early and often to avoid technical debt.
Write tests before code (TDD) for more robust software.
